formula: e_g=p_g-y_g; current W=sum(w*(abs(e1)+abs(e2))); oracle allocation W=sum(w*abs(e1+e2)), with p1+p2 unchanged. Group timestamps, SMP and k match exactly. Pearson correlation uses hours with positive total prediction.
limitations: Oracle uses known development targets and is not an attainable prediction result. It bounds reallocation-only changes that keep each current predicted total unchanged, not new forecasts or changes to the fixed composition. No official score inference.
